**PwC Korea reportedly blocks external AI tools after document leaks.** A consultant there says ChatGPT now triggers a "harmful website" warning, after staff uploaded internal documents to external tools. The internal alternative "has the confidence of a partner and the research skills of me on my first day." The cause is relayed as "the explanation making the rounds" and is not confirmed by PwC. [Reddit r/consulting, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1xre1bw/pwc_korea_blocked_chatgpt_apparently_desk/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-french-pmos-use-ai" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/french-pmos-use-ai/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="French PMOs use AI for reporting, rarely for risk or portfolio decisions." markdown>

**French PMOs use AI for reporting, rarely for risk or portfolio decisions.** Virage Group's 2026 PMO Observatory finds 73% use AI regularly and 85% name reporting time as the main benefit, but 84% do not use it to monitor the portfolio or produce recommendations. Confidentiality (63%) and sovereignty (52%) are the main barriers. The sample is 73 respondents, recruited among a tool vendor's clients and prospects. [Le Monde Informatique, 20 Oct 2026](https://www.lemondeinformatique.fr/actualites/lire-73-des-pmo-utilisent-l-ia-mais-moins-de-10-anticipent-les-risques-100859.html)
